name: memory-qa
description: Local-first QA investigation memory for recurring test failures, regression analysis, and reusable engineering knowledge.

scripts.lint: biome lint packages/core/src packages/core/test packages/cli/src packages/cli/test packages/mcp/src packages/mcp/test
scripts.format: biome format --write biome.json package.json tsconfig.json packages/core/package.json packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/core/src packages/core/test packages/cli/package.json packages/cli/tsconfig.json packages/cli/src packages/cli/test packages/mcp/package.json packages/mcp/tsconfig.json packages/mcp/src packages/mcp/test
scripts.format:check: biome format biome.json package.json tsconfig.json packages/core/package.json packages/core/tsconfig.json packages/core/src packages/core/test packages/cli/package.json packages/cli/tsconfig.json packages/cli/src packages/cli/test packages/mcp/package.json packages/mcp/tsconfig.json packages/mcp/src packages/mcp/test
scripts.quality: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.validate:clean: npm run clean && npm run quality && npm run typecheck && npm test
